en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a richly carved Renaissance-style altar or tabernacle inside a chapel. The structure features an arched top with a relief of a bearded figure flanked by angels, intricate floral and figurative carvings on the sides, and several standing saints or allegorical figures around a central panel. The altar table below has ornamental reliefs and candles placed on either side. Behind it, patterned wall decoration and faint mural paintings are visible. There is handwritten text in pencil beneath the image on the front and a short note in Hungarian on the divided back of the postcard.
